tool-report-feedback.title: Report feedback
tool-report-feedback.target_required: Open the current project and select an explicit node and integration protocol.
tool-report-feedback.status.idle: After running the report command, check the server inventory.
tool-report-feedback.status.checking: Reading the current project's node inventory…
tool-report-feedback.status.waiting: Waiting for new inventory from this node, for up to 60 seconds.
tool-report-feedback.status.current: A fresh inventory is available for review.
tool-report-feedback.status.new: New inventory received from this node.
tool-report-feedback.status.expired: This inventory has expired. Check again.
tool-report-feedback.status.unreported: This node has no inventory available for review.
tool-report-feedback.status.forbidden: This node cannot be accessed. Reading stopped and its observation was removed.
tool-report-feedback.status.unknown: The report state could not be confirmed. Check again; the command may have run.
tool-report-feedback.status.timed_out: Waiting ended without confirming new inventory. You can check again.
tool-report-feedback.no_matching: This inventory has no configuration matching the selected protocol.
tool-report-feedback.unavailable: This configuration cannot currently continue. Review the node's evidence.
tool-report-feedback.boundary: Inventory may come from an existing node and does not prove that the copied command or file ran. Returning checks the configuration again; registration and enabling remain explicit.
